Work with Azure Content Understanding using a native Go azd extension.

Manage analyzer definitions in your Microsoft Foundry resource.

Usage
  azd ai cu [command]

Available Commands
  analyze  : Analyze local files, directories, or HTTPS URLs
  analyzer : Manage Content Understanding analyzers
  config   : Manage CU user defaults without an azd project
  defaults : Read or update CU resource model deployment defaults, not local azd configuration
  doctor   : Check azd context, Entra authentication, CU access, and generative readiness
  env-var  : Inspect supported compatibility process variables safely
  infra    : Generate infrastructure and complete azd-managed provisioning
  version  : Display the extension version

Flags
  -v, --version : version for cu

Global Flags
  -C, --cwd string         : Sets the current working directory
      --debug              : Enables debug and diagnostics logging
  -e, --environment string : The name of the environment to use
  -h, --help               : help for cu
      --no-prompt          : Runs without prompts. Uses existing values; fails if any required value or decision cannot be resolved automatically.
  -o, --output string      : The output format (default "default")

Examples
  azd ai cu analyze invoice.pdf
    Analyze one file using the configured analyzer, or prebuilt-layout if unset.

  azd ai cu analyzer list
    List the analyzers available in the connected resource.

  azd ai cu doctor
    Check authentication, resource access, and model configuration.

Use azd ai cu [command] --help for more information about a command.
